observations: White multi-function printer on a wooden surface.
Control panel with a small LCD screen and buttons on the front left.
Paper input tray is extended at the bottom.
Model name 'LaserJet Pro MFP M130a' is visible on the front panel.
Power cable is connected to an extension block.

claims.evidence: The model name is printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The device is a Multi-Function Printer (MFP) with a flatbed scanner visible in photo 0.
The M130a model does not have fax capabilities; it lacks a numeric keypad and phone line ports.

risks.risk: Poor print quality or drum damage (streaks, spots, or fading).
risks.proof: A photo of a printed 'Configuration Report' or 'Supplies Status' page.
A photo of a successful scan or a copy made by the machine.

risks.risk: Toner cartridge is empty or near empty.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Supplies Status' page showing toner levels.
A clear photo of the rear ports.

proof_requests: Photo of a printed 'Supplies Status' page to verify print quality and toner levels.
Photo of the back of the printer to check the condition of the ports.
Short video of the printer making a photocopy to verify the scanner and paper path.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photo. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional/parts) until proof of operation is provided.
